mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and volume depletion may potentiate ezetimibe's effects and increase myopathy risk if combined with statins; ezetimibe has minimal direct interaction but loop diuretics increase cardiovascular risk in lipid-lowering therapy contexts.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain adequate potassium levels, and assess for muscle symptoms; ensure appropriate statin dosing if used concurrently with ezetimibe.
